field_summary.value: The Internet Quality Improvement and Evaluation System (iQIES) Provider of Services File (POS) includes provider demographic and associated certification information for Home Health Agency, Ambulatory Surgical Center, Hospice, Nursing Home, Organ Procurement Organization, Portable X-ray, End-Stage Renal Disease, Intermediate Care Facilities for Individuals with Intellectual Disabilities, Outpatient Physical Therapy/Speech Language Pathology, Comprehensive Outpatient Rehabilitation Facility, Federally Qualified Health Center, Rural Health Clinic, Psychiatric Residential Treatment Facility, and Community Mental Health Center providers. Additionally, you will find the provider number (CMS Certification Number), name, address, and other characteristics of the participating providers.
